title: Open-subspace factorization and its scheme tests
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $X,Y$ be algebraic spaces over $S$ [def-trf-algebraic-space], let $j:J\hookrightarrow X$ be an open subspace [def-a1-space-open-subspace], and let $f:Y\to X$ be any morphism. Point classes and their topology are [def-a1-space-point-topology]; products are sheaf fibre products [lem-trf-space-fibre-products-etale-covers]. The pullback $Y\times_XJ\to Y$ is an open subspace with point image $|f|^{-1}(|J|)$. If $\operatorname{im}|f|\subseteq|J|$, this pullback is isomorphic to $Y$ over $Y$, and there is a unique morphism $f_J:Y\to J$ with $j f_J=f$. For every scheme $T\to J$, the canonical comparison $Y\times_JT\xrightarrow{\sim}Y\times_XT$ is an isomorphism over $T$. Hence if $f$ is representable etale, then $f_J$ is representable etale; if also $\operatorname{im}|f|=|J|$, then $f_J$ is surjective on every scheme base change. For every algebraic space $G$ and every $g:G\to X$, the pullback $J_G=J\times_XG$ is an open subspace of $G$ with point image $|g|^{-1}(|J|)$. If $\operatorname{im}|f|=|J|$, then $\operatorname{im}(|Y\times_XG|\to|G|)=|J_G|$. No etaleness, flatness, surjectivity or finite-type assumption is imposed on $g$.

source.place: Tag 03IE (lemma-factor-through-open-subspace), Tag 06NF (lemma-etale-image-open, scheme-test argument), and Tag 03H4 (lemma-points-cartesian), arbitrary pullback of the open subspace.

proof.text: On each test scheme the square formed by Subfunctor.fromPreimage, the preimage inclusion, the open inclusion and the given map is a pullback: the inverse sends a compatible pair to its source section with its membership proof. Pull back the representing open scheme test of [def-a1-space-open-subspace] along the composite test map, and cancel this square, proving representable openness of the preimage. To apply [lem-a1-space-point-open-calculus], realize the open subfunctor as an algebraic space using [def-trf-algebraic-space]: representability over the ambient fppf sheaf proves its sheaf condition by gluing into each representing scheme; cancel the monic product inclusion from the ambient diagonal; pull back the ambient surjective etale atlas to obtain its atlas. The sheaf pullback and the literal preimage are isomorphic by their presheaf pullback squares. Point images are unchanged by a source isomorphism, so the point-calculus image formula identifies the preimage image with the inverse image of the open image. Apply this to both f and arbitrary g.

source.place: Tag 03IE (lemma-factor-through-open-subspace), first sentence of proof; Tag 03H4 (lemma-points-cartesian).

proof.text: Assume $\operatorname{im}|f|\subseteq|J|$. Step 1 gives full point image for the open subspace $p:Y\times_XJ\to Y$. By the last assertion of [lem-a1-space-point-open-calculus], an open subspace with full point image equals its ambient space, so $p$ is an isomorphism over $Y$. Compose its inverse with the projection to $J$ to obtain $f_J$; the pullback equation gives $j f_J=f$. Since $J$ is a subfunctor of $X$ by [def-a1-space-open-subspace], its inclusion is injective on sections over every scheme. Consequently two natural transformations $Y\to J$ with equal composites to $X$ agree on each test scheme, proving uniqueness.

For a scheme T mapping into J, take the presheaf pullback of the factor and the test map. Since the inclusion J into X is a monomorphism by [def-a1-space-open-subspace], postcomposing both maps with that inclusion preserves this pullback: a compatible pair over X is compatible over J by cancellation. Its unique comparison to the pullback over X therefore is an isomorphism. The universal-property equations give both required projection identities.

source.place: Tag 06NF (lemma-etale-image-open), scheme-test comparison in the proof.

proof.text: For every test T mapping into J, represent the scheme test of f along the composite T to X by [def-trf-algebraic-space]. Cancel the monomorphism J into X from the pullback square. The same scheme projection proves that the factor is representable etale. When the point images agree, any point of J maps to the image of f. Lift it to a representative of Y, then use injectivity of the point map of the open inclusion from [lem-a1-space-point-open-calculus] to see that the lift maps to the original point of J. Apply its representable surjectivity criterion to the factor, using the algebraic-space structure of J constructed in step 1.

Finally assume $\operatorname{im}|f|=|J|$ and let $g:G\to X$ be arbitrary. The fibre-product image formula of [lem-a1-space-point-open-calculus] gives $\operatorname{im}(|Y\times_XG|\to|G|)=|g|^{-1}(\operatorname{im}|f|)=|g|^{-1}(|J|)$. By step 1 this last subset is exactly the point image $|J_G|$ of the open subspace $J\times_XG\to G$. The formula applies to arbitrary morphisms; no etaleness or other extra condition on $g$ has been used.

source.place: Tag 03H4 (lemma-points-cartesian), applied to the arbitrary pullback; Tag 03IE (lemma-factor-through-open-subspace).
